Hola,

Espero que estéis pasando un buen verano. Igual ya os ha llegado por otras vías, pero nos escriben desde RConsortium (que os recuerdo nos apoya económicamente para mantener el MeetUp) para que difundamos esta breve encuesta:

-------- Mensaje reenviado --------
Asunto: R Consortium Survey
Fecha: Thu, 13 Jul 2017 11:06:12 -0700






Dear R User Group Organizers,

The R Consortium is attempting to survey R users worldwide. We would like to know some basic information: How people use R, What they think of the way R is developing, What other languages they use, etc. You can read more about its purpose in a recent post by Hadley Wickham and myself on the R Consortium blog. When the analysis is complete we will share the results of the survey.

We would very much appreciate it if you could pass on the link to the survey to your user group members and encourage everyone to participate. 

We intend to make this survey an annual event. We hope that it will become a means to further strengthen the bonds of the R Community.

Thank you and best regards,

Joe
